component.name: Acer Control Center — Linux Edition
component.summary: Industrial-Technical Hardware Command Center for Acer Aspire 7 A715-59G on Fedora Linux

description.p: Acer Control Center — Linux Edition is a native C++23 and Qt 6 Quick desktop hardware management and telemetry application engineered for the Acer Aspire 7 A715-59G on Fedora Linux 45.

It provides real-time CPU, memory, thermal, battery, and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 telemetry, verified Intel P-State and TuneD/PPD performance profile management, interactive fan curve preview (preserving Firmware Automatic EC control), a capability-aware Keyboard Lighting Studio (clean-room CLV0001 ACPI _DSM 0x67 17-preset and static 24-bit custom RGB backend, /sys/class/leds sysfs backend, and sRGB/HSV/HSL Preview Studio independent of the application theme accent color), and privacy-redacted hardware diagnostics.
